description: This Kotlin source file defines a ViewModel class for managing UI state in a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It handles state persistence across configuration changes, interacts with a GameEngine to process moves, and exposes UI state through a data class. The class uses Android Architecture Components such as SavedStateHandle to maintain game state, and includes methods for handling cell taps, restarts, and marking outcomes as shown.

classes.name: TicTacToeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing UI state for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, handling game logic integration, state persistence, and exposing UI state for reactive updates.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles a user tap on a game cell at the specified index, updating the game state via the GameEngine.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state and updates the saved state handle.

methods.name: markOutcomeShown
methods.description: Marks that the game outcome has been displayed to the user.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves the current game state into the SavedStateHandle for persistence.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the game state from SavedStateHandle or resets if unavailable.
